title: All-or-error JSON Lines reader
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag raising instead of returning the valid prefix of a file. That is the stated all-or-error contract: silently returning a prefix would let a truncated or corrupt file masquerade as complete, so the reader discards staged records and names the offending line.
